pages.title: Typhlotic Armor
pages.text: Snuffur and banshee membrane can be crafted into a set of typhlotic armor. Each piece of this armor reduces Self damage by 25% and converts 25% of the experience lost upon death into a sculk bloom.

If you journey to one of the dark interstitial chasms where regions of the Ruins meet and plunge into the void, you can perform a special ritual. Place a piece of typhlotic armor in an item focus, influenced by 21 Self and hallows containing 99 protection spirits. The armor will be imbued with Mending and Protection V (a higher level than is possible via normal enchanting).
